explication: SerenityOS is a graphical Unix-like operating system. Its principal user workflow is interacting with GUI applications, including the browser, which relies on userland libraries and OS services; system calls then connect userland to the kernel and hardware. The README documents broader networking, filesystems, security, and desktop capabilities, while the sampled source gives detail only for selected web, storage, and kernel-device components. Accordingly, broader subsystem links are shown only where documented; unsampled internal wiring is omitted.
